title: ScamWorld: An Interactive Environment for Evaluating Web Agents Against Online Fraud
abstract: arXiv:2611.04879v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Web agents increasingly browse, shop, and manage accounts on behalf of their users. Prior work has shown that they can be misled by adversarial content, including prompt injections and deceptive interfaces. Beyond such attacks, agents operating on the open web also encounter online fraud designed to deceive humans, including fraudulent online stores, fake investment platforms, and advance-fee schemes. How web agents respond to such fraud during task execution remains underexplored, in part because scam websites are short-lived, making systematic evaluation difficult. To address this gap, we introduce ScamWorld, an interactive environment that reconstructs reported scam websites across diverse scenarios, fraud mechanisms, and languages. Each reconstructed website reproduces documented fraud mechanisms, making relevant signs of fraud observable before the agent's final action and enabling controlled, repeatable evaluation. translated_title: ScamWorld：一个用于评估网络智能体应对在线诈骗的交互式环境
translated_abstract: 网络智能体越来越多地代表用户进行网页浏览、购物和账户管理。先前的研究表明，它们可能被对抗性内容误导，包括提示注入和欺骗性界面。除了此类攻击之外，在开放网络上运行的智能体还会遇到旨在欺骗人类的在线诈骗，例如欺诈性网店、虚假投资平台和预付费骗局。然而，网络智能体在任务执行过程中如何应对此类诈骗仍缺乏充分研究，部分原因在于诈骗网站寿命短暂，使系统性评估难以开展。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 ScamWorld——一个交互式环境，它能够在多样化的场景、诈骗机制和语言下重建已被举报的诈骗网站。每个重建的网站都复现了有据可查的诈骗机制，使相关诈骗迹象在智能体采取最终行动之前即可被观察到，从而实现受控且可重复的评估。
tldr: 本文提出 ScamWorld，一个通过在多场景、多机制、多语言下重建真实诈骗网站，从而对网络智能体识别与应对在线诈骗能力进行受控、可重复评估的交互式环境。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ScamWorld, an interactive environment that reconstructs reported scam websites across diverse scenarios, fraud mechanisms, and languages, enabling controlled and repeatable evaluation of how web agents recognize and respond to online fraud.
